MAJOR: Startup attestation is fail-closed for the whole binary: one corrupted embedded asset prevents boot of APIs/health too, with no degraded mode, no precedence vs `PF_CONSOLE_STATIC_DIR`, and no alert lead-time (guardrails 2/4) — scope the failure to the console subsystem or state the operator recovery path.

Rollback path is not executable in the field: AC-3 packages ship only the binary, yet the external-dir rollback needs a verified console bundle on the host; design defines no source, integrity check, or restore procedure for it (guardrails 1/6).

`design_pack.tooling: False` contradicts DEC-1553-03's "build-time asset compilation is tooling" justification for `core/packaging.py:compile_web_console`; language-rule compliance (guardrail 7) is unresolvable until one authoritative classification is pinned.

Declared `go/web/console_test.go` has zero traceability/test_matrix entries; AC-2 proof rests on a single pipeline pytest whose relationship to the real Go handler (build+invoke vs reimplement) is unstated, leaving CL-001 single-writer/test-integrity unproven.
MINOR: EAP asset-bundle registration (`config/eap-registry.json`) has no version/skew contract: nothing states the embedded bundle version must match the platform/API version or that an external-dir bundle is version-checked before serving.
No readiness/health signal distinguishes console-asset failure from API failure for operators (guardrail 2 alert lead-time); current observability is request logs plus packaging exit codes only.
Route ownership/registration point of `ServeConsoleMux` inside the existing server mux is unspecified (CL-001 "register it"); design names the handler but not the owning mux or route-by-kind class.
NIT: `index.html` is `no-cache` but no revalidation mechanism (ETag/Last-Modified) is specified, forcing full re-download of the entry document on every navigation.
Gzip threshold/min-size is unstated, so small JSON/JS payloads pay compression latency without payload benefit against the sub-millisecond NFR.
SUMMARY: Design is directionally sound (embed.FS, fail-closed IP guard, SPA/API route separation) but Gate 1.5 cannot approve: fail-closed startup blast radius, a rollback path that cannot run in the field, contradictory tooling/language-rule metadata, and missing Go-side test evidence must be resolved first.
Per CL-006, all previously reported PENDING MAJORs must carry dispositions before approval; top risks are availability regression at boot and unproven AC-2 evidence.
